p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, licence, EC standards
p.espaces.cu_inco: International Trade Terms 2020: Who Payes What
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods, after export clearance, to the buyer ' s carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on board the ship; then the buyer bears the risk and costs.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance until port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: Delivery at destination: The seller delivers the goods to the destination and the buyer pays the import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeit products, protected species (CITES), some medicines.
p.espaces.cu_find: Finding a freight forwarder or carrier
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: International Chamber of Commerce (International Trade Terms 2020), International Trade Centre, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr.
p.espaces.mt_d: Compare the fees in your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you can compare here, then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Global remittance rates (World Bank): real cost of transferring funds, by country and by service

p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Transfer to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Consider the sum: fees + exchange rate. Any price worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose the way the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is often required, both for sending and for receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you met online, or to "unlock" a prize, a job, a loan, or a visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: Finding a supplier, setting the real price, and complying with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Retail means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. It’s easy to get started, but you remain responsible for selling.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers ' country: no counterfeit, no unlicensed regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Look for a supplier (list "wholesale/supplier" here or wholesale platforms) and request a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, value added tax in the customer ' s country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, value added tax and taxes according to your country (see business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for customer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.

p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel coming from outside the European Union is subject to value added tax from the first euro.
